info.title: UltraBERT-380M Name That LLM 5-fold
info.subtitle: dmis-lab/UltraBERT-380M fine-tuned, 5 GroupKFold folds + transformers 5 wheels
info.description: 5 GroupKFold (by prompt_id) fine-tunes of dmis-lab/UltraBERT-380M (Apache-2.0) for the Name That LLM competition. fp16 safetensors. OOF balanced accuracy 0.408. `wheels/` contains transformers==5.16.1 and deps for offline install.
